name: Bright Data
summary: Pre-built site scrapers, Web Unlocker, SERP API and Marketplace datasets from Bright Data.

api_key.description: a Bright Data API key (control panel > Account settings > API keys)

notes: Web Unlocker and SERP calls also need a zone name (BRIGHTDATA_ZONE in .env.example), passed as the zone body field.
Scraper results default to NDJSON; set format=json for an array.
New accounts get a monthly free credit allowance across Web Unlocker, SERP and Scraper APIs.

endpoints.name: Run a pre-built scraper and return the records
endpoints.summary: Run one of Bright Data's pre-built site scrapers and get the records back in the same response.

dataset_id.description: Scraper dataset id (gd_...); look it up in https://docs.brightdata.com/scrapers.json.

input.description: Inputs to scrape, a list of objects whose fields depend on the scraper (e.g. url or user_name).

limit_per_input.description: Most records to return per input; mainly for discovery requests.

custom_output_fields.description: Output fields to keep, separated by a pipe, e.g. url|title.

include_errors.description: Include an errors report with the results.

format.description: Response format; default ndjson, one record per line.

type.description: discover_new for scrapers with a discovery phase.

discover_by.description: Discovery method for discover_new, which differs per scraper.

notes: A read over POST: it collects data and changes nothing in your account.
Times out after 1 minute with HTTP 202 and a snapshot_id; then poll scraper.progress and fetch scraper.snapshot. One input per call is recommended.

endpoints.name: Start an asynchronous scraper collection
endpoints.summary: Start a batch collection and get a snapshot_id to poll and download.

dataset_id.description: Scraper dataset id (gd_...); look it up in https://docs.brightdata.com/scrapers.json.

input.description: Inputs to scrape, a list of objects whose fields depend on the scraper (e.g. url or user_name).

limit_per_input.description: Most records to return per input; mainly for discovery requests.

custom_output_fields.description: Output fields to keep, separated by a pipe.

include_errors.description: Include an errors report with the results.

type.description: discover_new for scrapers with a discovery phase.

discover_by.description: Discovery method for discover_new, which differs per scraper.

endpoint.description: Webhook URL called when the collection finishes.

auth_header.description: Authorization header sent with the webhook delivery.

notes: A read over POST: it starts a job that only produces data.
Async pattern: trigger returns snapshot_id; poll scraper.progress until status is ready; download with scraper.snapshot.

endpoints.name: Check a collection's progress
endpoints.summary: Status of a snapshot: collecting, processing or ready.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot id returned when a collection was triggered.

endpoints.name: Download a collection's records
endpoints.summary: Download the records of a snapshot once its status is ready.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot id returned when a collection was triggered.

format.description: Download format; default ndjson, one record per line.

batch_size.description: Split into batches of this many records.

part.description: Which batch to download when batch_size is set.

endpoints.name: Fetch a URL through Web Unlocker
endpoints.summary: Fetch any page past anti-bot protection and CAPTCHAs through a Web Unlocker zone.

zone.description: Name of your Web Unlocker or SERP zone (BRIGHTDATA_ZONE in .env.example).

url.description: Full target URL, http or https.

format.description: raw returns the page body, json wraps status and body.

country.description: Two-letter proxy country code, e.g. us.

notes: A read over POST: it fetches the page and changes nothing in your account.
Needs a Web Unlocker zone created in the Bright Data control panel; pass its name as zone.

endpoints.name: Run a search-engine query through the SERP API
endpoints.summary: Structured results from Google, Bing, Yandex or DuckDuckGo, from a search URL.

zone.description: Name of your Web Unlocker or SERP zone (BRIGHTDATA_ZONE in .env.example).

url.description: The search-engine URL to fetch, e.g. https://www.google.com/search?q=pizza.

format.description: raw returns the page body, json wraps status and body.

country.description: Two-letter proxy country code, e.g. us.

notes: A read over POST: it runs a search and changes nothing in your account.
Needs a SERP API zone; pass its name as zone. Use format json for parsed results.

endpoints.name: List Marketplace datasets
endpoints.summary: The Marketplace datasets your account can query.

endpoints.name: Get a Marketplace dataset's fields
endpoints.summary: Fields, types and descriptions of one dataset, to read before filtering it.

endpoints.name: Create a snapshot of a dataset filtered by field values
endpoints.summary: Start a bulk async job that selects records of a Marketplace dataset matching a filter.

filter.description: Filter object, e.g. {"name": "name", "operator": "includes", "value": "Egor"}; conditions can be combined.

records_limit.description: Most records to include in the snapshot.

notes: A read over POST: it creates a data snapshot and changes nothing else.
Async: returns a snapshot_id; the docs say a job can take up to 5 minutes. Dataset records are billed at $2.5 per thousand records at the time of writing.
